title: Hearts and mana stars from kills; magnet respects a full inventory; floating/glowing item flags
player_outcome: Killing enemies while hurt sometimes drops a pulsing heart (+20 life), and while low on mana a mana star. Bosses spill several hearts. Items no longer orbit you when your inventory is full; they stay on the ground. Souls float.
design: Verified: NpcSystem.Kill drops only loot and coins; no heart/star items exist. DroppedItemSystem magnetises regardless of space (DroppedItems.cs:155), so leftovers orbit the player.
ItemDef: Pickup (PickupEffect { HealLife, HealMana }; items with it are never stored), NoGravity (bool), Glows (bool).

New Core Gameplay/Items/PickupConfig.cs + data/config/pickups.json { dropChance: 1/6 (verify against Terraria), bossHearts [5, 9], magnetRange 3.2, pickupRange 1.0, pullSpeed 9 }. Loaded like SpawnConfig (NpcSystem.Pickups; defaults in code).
NpcSystem.Death (P3-19 file): unless critter or Damage == 0, roll dropChance for the nearest player. A mana star if mana < max (50%), else a heart if life < max. Bosses always spill bossHearts.

DroppedItemSystem.Tick(..., Func<ItemStack, bool> canTake): magnetise only when canTake. Otherwise apply normal gravity and ground friction (no orbit). Pickup items always 'fit'. NoGravity items drift with damping and bob.

GameWorld drop collector: items with Pickup → Vitals.Heal / RestoreMana, then raise a new event PickupApplied(p, item, life, mana). Show green/blue numbers via DamageEvent Kind Heal/Mana (P2 colours) and play 'heart_pickup' / 'mana_star_pickup'.
Canonical grab range via StatIds.GrabRange ('grabRange') added to magnetRange (Treasure Magnet later).
Assets: 'heart' and 'star' items in assets.json (existing heart/star generators, glow).
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.cs — collector applies pickups; canTake from Backpack/Coins/Ammo CanFit
data/items/materials.json — heart, star; souls noGravity; fallen_star glows
data_changes: New items: heart ('Heart', pickup {healLife 20}, glows) and star ('Star', pickup {healMana 100}, glows); tag 'pickup' so the validator's obtainability check passes
noGravity true on soul_of_light, soul_of_night, soul_of_flight, soul_of_might, soul_of_sight, soul_of_fright (those present)
tests: PickupTests: with the player at 50/100 life and a seeded rng, 60 zombie kills produce ≥ 1 heart; touching it heals 20 and nothing enters the backpack
PickupTests: with a full backpack, a dirt drop 2 m away stays ≥ 1.5 m away after 120 ticks
PickupTests: a soul drop keeps its height (no gravity)
Smoke combat.cmds: 'hurt 50' (new command from P3-33, or add here) / 'spawn zombie 12 4' / 'slay' / 'wait 1' / 'probe drops.heart' (informative)
verification: Lavapipe screenshot of a heart drop
risks: The 'star' id may confuse with fallen_star; keep Terraria's display name 'Star' and document it.
Heal-number colours are P2's CombatText; coordinate the DamageKind usage.
